messages:
Anya S.: Quick post-QBR retro — thanks everyone. Dropping notes & owners; please ack and add missing items. TL;DR: slides updated, renewals: Acme (at-risk), onboarding blockers: API keys + sample data, enablement: training recording + playbook draft.

Mike C.: Ack. I'll own the Acme renewal follow-up. Scheduling exec touchpoint w/ AMs tomorrow.

Sarah O.: Will update slides with the new churn chart (slide 7). Running `./scripts/generate-qbr --include-churn` after edits.

Jordan (SE): Noted. I'll attach the deep-dive logs for the onboarding latency incident.

Neil Eng: Did we commit to a fallback model for low-capacity regions? Need to know for the runbook.

Anya S.: Yes — fallback plan is Model-lite v1.4; add to SLA slide and runbook. @Neil Eng please add quantized perf numbers.

Karen CSM: I'm blocked waiting on Acme's procurement team — asked for compliance docs. @Mike C. can you nudge?

Mike C.: On it. Also prepping a short ask for execs: 15-min alignment call to agree renewal concessions.

Anya S.: Action owners list: Acme renewal — Mike C.; slide update + churn chart — Sarah O.; onboarding ticket triage — Jordan; runbook perf numbers — Neil Eng; training recording + playbook — Karen CSM. Any objections?

Sarah O.: fine. ETA for slide update EOD today.

Jordan (SE): I'll triage tickets and push fixes by tomorrow noon.

Neil Eng: I'll add perf numbers + short note on quantization tradeoffs by EOD.

Karen CSM: I'll record the training clip and share transcript by Friday.

Anya S.: Two follow-ups: 1) Exec dry-run — who can present the ask? 2) Risk note for finance — need ARR impact estimate.

Mike C.: I can present. @lisa.finance please chime in with ARR calc.

lisa.finance: Adding ARR calc: for Acme potential churn, risk = ~$120k ARR if not renewed. Will post breakdown.

Anya S.: Great. Also capturing feedback items: customers asked for clearer error codes, more onboarding sample datasets, and an SLA figure. Add to backlog.

Jordan (SE): Logged new GH issue: #482-onboarding-samples. Link: https://github.com/redwoodinc/infra/issues/482

Anya S.: Cool. Last: Can everyone react :thumbsup: when you've completed your action. I'll compile and send a follow-up doc.

Mike C.: :thumbsup:

Sarah O.: :thumbsup:

Jordan (SE): :thumbsup:

Neil Eng: :thumbsup:

Karen CSM: :thumbsup:

Anya S.: Thanks — I'll post the follow-up doc in the channel and in the QBR board.
